name: Gold Note
_refused: Gold Note's Terms of Use (goldnote.it/termini-di-utilizzo/, « Version November 2026 »), section 3 « Permitted use and intellectual property »: browsing and downloading are allowed « for information », and « Further reproduction, modification, distribution or commercial use requires the authorisation of the rights holder » (Italian original: « Ulteriori riproduzioni, modifiche, distribuzioni o impieghi commerciali richiedono l'autorizzazione del titolare dei diritti »), with « Systematic collection and reuse of content must respect intellectual property rights ». Softer in tone than most of the register and the same in effect: publishing this catalogue is further reproduction and distribution, and no authorisation has been sought. The same reading was applied to Luxman, whose clause has the same shape. NO DEVICE RECORD MAY BE WRITTEN under this brand until Gold Note is asked and answers.
